title: Primary Six Mathematics — Term 3
summary: Six 40-minute lessons each week. The OSEB school scheme sets weeks 1–2; other school schemes complete the term sequence. Only weeks 1–2 are authorised for detailed notes and plans in this run. The final period is reserved for assessment.
